briefdescription.para: The operations exposed by BlockLoad require a temporary memory allocation of this nested type for thread communication. This opaque storage can be allocated directly using the __shared__ keyword. Alternatively, it can be aliased to externally allocated memory (shared or global) or union'd with other storage allocation types to facilitate memory reuse.
